rules.spawn_rule: One attempt every 105 engine tics; occupied pads are skipped. Alternate types when possible, filling the other type when one reaches its four-enemy cap. At most eight living enemies.
rules.enemy: DoomImp (30 health, native projectile/melee AI, Clip drop) and native Zombieman (20 health, hitscan attacks, Clip drop); at most four of each
rules.ammo: Four ClipBox pickup pads; each respawns eight game seconds after collection. Enemy kills drop a Clip.
rules.episode_end: player death only; no time limit or level exit
rules.neural_state: preserved across arena resets; baseline synaptic weights are fixed
rules.observation_boundary: Enemy counts, item counters and other engine state are spectator telemetry only. Controller input remains RGB pixels.
rules.comparison: New environment revision; do not pool with combat-survival-v1, defend_the_center or blue-floor learning experiments. V1 permits eight projectile-only survivors and a circling stalemate.

manifest.retina_model: R1-R6 luminance-only. Column inferred from all contacts onto annotated L1/L2/L3; modal column. Experimental overlapping viewport projection, not calibrated retinal angles.
manifest.visual_dynamics: Photoreceptors and lamina are graded in vivo. This experiment uses an explicit LIF proxy, low-pass luminance drive and tonic lamina current; it is not validated fly vision.
manifest.motor_interface: Experimental visual-neuron BCI: DNp20 R-L turns; DNpe017 summed rate moves forward and its spikes press attack. Chosen interface, not natural fly actions. Biological-role readouts retained as comparison.
manifest.training: No synaptic plasticity. Optional score-contingent sugar input is stimulation, not learning.

retina.measurement: Raw normalized frame luminance; not firing rate or a reconstructed subjective view.

protocol.input_filter: 10 ms discrete low-pass, updated once per game interval; resulting current held for that interval
protocol.frame_timing: JPEG of pre-action input frame; game counters are post-action; raw RGB hash differs from compressed JPEG hash
protocol.hosting: local broadcaster; unavailable if host sleeps or disconnects
